documents.unit: Faculty Senate (hosted on Morris Library research guide)
documents.title: AI: Guidelines for SIUC Faculty
documents.date_or_term: Faculty Senate adopted July 2024; page accessed 2026-10-25
documents.stance_why: The page says the Senate guidelines "are general by design to allow individual faculty members to chose the tools and policies best suited for their students and courses" and sets no default; it only encourages a syllabus statement, so delegates.
documents.summary: A library research-guide page summarizing the July 2024 Faculty Senate guidelines: be transparent about AI costs, include a syllabus statement, and learn about the harms of AI requirements or bans. It leaves policy to instructors and adds a librarian's labelled opinions, e.g. against blanket bans.

units.why: Describes the Senate guidelines as "general by design" so "individual faculty members" choose policies; this hands the decision to instructors, so P04 (instructor sets rule).
units.anchor: general by design to allow individual faculty members to chose the tools and policies

units.why: States the Faculty Senate adopted guidelines on AI in "teaching and research" in July 2024; this records who made the policy and when, so P84.
